summary: Complete architectural and implementation plan for the isolated Underground Mining & Exploration suite in ESWA. Features the 3-pillar Main Window (Underground Face Mapping, Exploration Core Logging, Data Storage), the multi-step face mapping setup wizard (Project, Location, Face/Chainage, Custom Stope Profile with presets/parametric/DXF, and Field vs Photogrammetry mode choice), a dedicated single-face mining canvas (no crown/walls, no joint sets/strip logs) with vein/ore boundary tracing, interactive channel sampling lines with weighted assay calculation, Laubscher MRMR & Mathews Potvin stope stability (N = Q' * A * B * C), and professional mine planning exports (Surpac/Deswik DXF, PDF Face Sheet, CSV channel samples), strictly isolated from NATM and TBM.
